About the job
Amstelhaven Industries is a listed group of specialty packaging and coatings businesses with EUR 2.4 billion in revenue, 9,800 employees and 41 production sites in 17 countries. Our addressable spend of EUR 1.6 billion is managed by a procurement organisation of 180 people at group, regional and site level.

Our Chief Procurement Officer will leave the company at the end of the year. While the search for a permanent successor is ongoing, we are looking for an Interim CPO to lead the function and keep our procurement transformation programme on track.

The role
- Lead the global procurement organisation (direct and indirect spend) as a member of the Group Executive Committee
- Own the procurement strategy and the EUR 90 million savings target for 2027, including the negotiation of the top 50 supplier contracts
- Steer the second wave of our Source-to-Pay transformation (SAP Ariba globally, Coupa for indirect spend in North America)
- Strengthen supplier risk management, including dual sourcing for critical resins and pigments and readiness for the EU CSDDD
- Work with Internal Audit on the redesign of the purchase-to-pay controls
- Coach and assess the category directors and regional procurement heads, and prepare the handover to the permanent CPO

What you bring
- 20+ years of experience in procurement, of which at least 10 years as CPO or Group Head of Procurement in a listed industrial company
- A track record of delivering audited savings of more than EUR 50 million per year
- Experience in leading procurement organisations of 150+ people across several continents
- Board-level communication and stakeholder management
- Fluent English; Dutch or German is a plus

Engagement
- Start in January 2027 for 9 to 12 months
- On-site at our head office in Amsterdam (Zuidas) four days per week, frequent travel to our sites in Europe and Asia
- Day rate between EUR 1,600 and 1,900, depending on experience

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies.
